# SO THE INSTRUMENT ENDS FIVE YEARS BEFORE THE FAMILY STARTS. Martha Maud was baptised at Baldock on
# 22 September 1895 and that entry is not in this set either - the latest Martha Castle at Baldock is 1876.
# THE ROW IS NOT ANSWERED. The two unnamed children are still unnamed. What is now known is WHY, and
# that the answer lies in the Baldock parish register at Hertfordshire Archives rather than in any index.
# THE ONE FIND, AND IT IS WORTH HAVING: the first baptism this archive has read for ANY of Caroline's
# children. It gives the father's forenames as GEORGE WILLIAM and his trade as LABOURER, and it puts the
# family at WESTON in 1887 - Caroline's own birthplace, and the village where SARAH ANN WALLIS was born
# on 19 August 1882, two months before the marriage. The Weston thread is now three strands.
# AND A CORRECTION TO THE MATCH-HOLDER'S TREE, found while following Ada May forward:
#   HER MARRIAGE     Q4 1909, HITCHIN, volume 3A page 1171. She was twenty-two.
#   THE TREE SAYS    "Ada May Castle, died Jul 1969, Hitchin"
#   THE INDEX SAYS   NO SUCH DEATH. Ada* Castle born 1884-1890, all England and Wales: sixteen entries,
#                    NOT ONE at Hitchin and NOT ONE in 1969.
# A woman who married in 1909 did not die a Castle in 1969, and this is the Caroline James trap exactly:
# a tree records a death under a maiden surname the woman had not used for sixty years. Her married
# surname is unknown and is NOT guessed here. Findmypast's MarriageFinder offers Thomas Redman or
# Sidney Smith; THOSE ARE PAGE-MATES IN AN INDEX, NOT A MARRIAGE, and neither is written down as a husband.
# The certificate, 3A/1171, would name the husband and her father in one line.
